output_contract.loss_contract: raw absolute error at most requested bound; framework verifies every finite value
output_contract.tolerance_identity: requested decimal and exact actual power-of-two tolerance both recorded

lifecycle_contract.output_bound: upstream zfp_stream_maximum_size per 1D field plus checked project framing and raw-exception maximum
lifecycle_contract.error_codes: stable tscb_status_v1 with strict descriptor, capacity and checksum validation
lifecycle_contract.reset: ABI reset clears object state and native timing while preserving enablement

stream_components.outer_container: 12-byte unique prefix plus canonical dtype/shape/name/track/mode descriptors
stream_components.native_header: version, dtype width, fixed-accuracy mode, full-header policy, dimensions, requested and actual tolerances
stream_components.column_records: kind, exact logical count, zfp header bit count, stored byte count and payload
stream_components.zfp_stream: independent serial 1D stream with ZFP_HEADER_FULL for every finite regular column
stream_components.raw_exception: whole column stored exactly for NaN, infinity, negative zero or subnormal; all bytes charged
stream_components.checksum: 64-bit FNV-1a over the complete native frame before the checksum field
stream_components.accounting: all outer descriptor and native physical bytes charged exactly once; capacities are excluded

upstream_tests.suite: project native ABI smoke across float32/float64 and 1D tail boundaries
same ABI smoke under ASan/UBSan including corruption, canary and bound-minus-one

known_limitations: Only serial CPU fixed-accuracy float32/float64 execution is admitted.
Each UTS/MTS channel is an independent 1D zfp field; this result does not represent zfp native 2D/3D/4D scientific-array throughput.
Fixed-rate, fixed-precision and reversible modes require separate AlgorithmIDs and are not accepted by this adapter.
OpenMP, CUDA, strided fields, validity masks, query and streaming protocols are not registered.
Columns containing NaN, infinity, negative zero or subnormal values use fully charged raw exception records; this policy is part of the algorithm identity.
The benchmark validates the requested raw absolute error bound independently even though zfp rounds the requested tolerance down to an actual power of two.
